# Timing Utilities[¶](https://docs.sympy.org/dev/modules/utilities/timeutils.html#module-sympy.utilities.timeutils)

Simple tools for timing functions’ execution, when IPython is not available.

   sympy.utilities.timeutils.timed(  *func: Callable[[], object]*, *setup: str = 'pass'*, *limit: int | None = None*,  ) → tuple[int, float, float, str][[source]](https://github.com/sympy/sympy/blob/2d283a82d15f2b46beff7be5399546c79613c445/sympy/utilities/timeutils.py#L14-L36)[¶](https://docs.sympy.org/dev/modules/utilities/timeutils.html#sympy.utilities.timeutils.timed)

Adaptively measure execution time of a function.
